wrappers or cans,
left lying on the ground.

when I do it and it's a failure,
everything about it makes me hate it.

especially if I ask them lots of questions when they're making their breakfast.

The adjectives, annoying and irritating describe something that makes you feel uncomfortable or angry

Georgie just gave the adjectives that describe the situation, but annoyed or irritated describe
the way you feel. So if you are annoyed or irritated, something has made you angry.
